name: pagong
description: Search Korean court auctions, Onbid public sales, and bankruptcy sales with factual yield and market-ratio data.

interface.longDescription:
Pagong looks up live Korean real-estate auction listings: court auctions, KAMCO Onbid public sales, and bankruptcy-trustee sales.

What it does: search active listings by region, property type, and minimum bid; get a fact summary for one court-auction case (prices, round, sale date, expected yield with its inputs, ratio to nearby market prices with sample size, whether a tenant deposit may be assumed by the buyer, share-sale status); and explain how each metric is calculated.

Who it is for: people researching Korean property auctions who want factual figures before reading the original court documents.

Limits: computed values (expected yield, market ratio, assumption status) are filled only for the top 3 results of a court search; other results return a link to the full page. Onbid and bankruptcy searches return summaries and links only. All figures are factual data, not investment advice, ratings, or recommendations. Coverage is South Korea only, and results are in Korean.
defaultPrompt: Find Seoul apartment court auctions with the sale date coming up soonest
Show Gyeonggi court auctions with expected yield above 6% and no assumed tenant deposit
How is expected yield calculated for Korean auction listings?

positive.description: Search court auctions by region and type
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 5 Seoul apartment court-auction items sorted by nearest sale date, each with case number, address, minimum bid, sale date and a pagong.net URL. Only the first 3 items include expected yield, market ratio and assumption status; items 4-5 have these as null and point to the URL. No recommendation.

positive.description: Filter by expected yield and no assumed deposit
positive.prompt: 경기도에서 예상 수익률 6% 이상이고 인수 보증금 없는 경매 물건 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Gyeonggi court-auction items filtered to expected yield >= 6% and confirmed no assumed deposit, with rent sample counts and comparison tiers for the top 3. Presents figures as facts, not advice.

Returns the case's prices, failed-bid count, sale date, expected yield with its formula inputs, market ratio with sample size and tier, real cost, assumption status and share-sale flag, plus a URL for full specification details.

Returns the published definition: (median nearby deposit x 6% + median monthly rent x 12) / real cost x 100, with the conditions under which it is not calculated (fewer than 3 rent samples, share sales, assumed tenant deposits).

positive.prompt: 부산 주거용 온비드 공매랑 부동산 파산공매 최근 물건 3건씩 알려줘
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 3 Busan residential Onbid items and up to 3 recent bankruptcy-sale real-estate items as summaries (name, address, minimum bid, dates, status) with pagong.net URLs; no computed metrics.

negative.prompt: 이 물건 사도 돼? 낙찰 받으면 무조건 이득이지?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not give a buy/sell judgment or guarantee. May show factual figures (yield, market ratio, assumption status) and suggests checking the original court documents or a professional.

negative.prompt: Find foreclosure auctions in Los Angeles
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the app only covers South Korean auctions and does not return US listings.

negative.prompt: 이 사건 채무자 이름이랑 연락처 알려줘
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses; the tools do not provide debtor personal information. Offers case facts and the public listing URL only.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Five read-only tools: search_court, get_court_facts, explain_metric, search_onbid and search_bankruptcy. Computed values (expected yield, market ratio, assumption status) are included for the top 3 court-auction results.

ko-KR.subtitle: 한국 경매·공매 사실 데이터
ko-KR.description:
파공넷은 한국의 진행 중인 법원경매·온비드 공매·파산공매 물건을 조회합니다.

지역·용도·최저가로 물건을 검색하고, 법원경매 물건 1건의 사실 요약(가격·회차·매각기일, 산식 입력값이 붙은 예상 수익률, 표본 수가 붙은 주변 시세 대비, 인수 보증금 유무, 지분 매각 여부)을 보며, 각 지표의 산식을 확인할 수 있습니다.

한계: 계산값은 법원경매 검색 상위 3건에만 채워지고 나머지는 상세 링크로 안내합니다. 온비드·파산공매는 요약과 링크만 제공합니다. 모든 수치는 사실 정보이며 투자 추천이나 판정이 아닙니다. 대한민국 데이터만 다루며 결과는 한국어입니다.
